text.description_html:
CanaropaJNF-FP231-180-630, Satin Stainless Steel 7" Oblong Flush Pull

Stainless steel has a reputation of being very modern in appearance, but we find that this easy to care for material is not just for contemporary homes. The 7 Inch Oval Satin Stainless Steel Flush Pull is modern yes, but the oblong shape helps give it a warmth that sharp angles cannot provide. The satin stainless steel gives this flush pull a very "now" style while looking great even with heavy use. This pull is sizable, measuring 7-1/16 inches long and 2-11/32 inches wide, making it a great focal point for sliding doors. It has a 1/16 inch projection so it is a great pocket door handle. Comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Specifications for the Long Oval Sliding Pocket Door Handle:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Length: 7-1/16"
  • Width: 2-11/32"
  • Projection: 1/16"
  • Door Cutout Depth: 1/2"
  • Door Cutout Length: 5-25/32"
  • Door Cutout Width: 1-17/32"
  • Finger Cutout Length: 5-1/2"
  • Finger Cutout Width: 1-1/16"

Sold Individually
